reviews.title: experiencing a translation
reviews.body:
Hello Facebook Team,

I am experiencing a translation issue on Facebook. The translation feature is not working correctly.

Many posts and comments are being translated into Chinese instead of my preferred language. My iPhone language is set correctly, and I have already tried changing the language settings, reinstalling the Facebook app, and resetting my device settings, but the problem still persists.

Please investigate and fix this issue. Thank you.
